title: About Nootiq
subtitle: Transforming the way you study with artificial intelligence

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: At Nootiq, we believe learning should be more efficient, personalized, and accessible. Our mission is to transform any document into interactive study material using the power of artificial intelligence.

story.title: Our Story
story.content: Born from the real need of students who spent hours manually creating flashcards and summaries. We decided to automate this process so you can focus on what really matters: learning.

ai_processing.title: Advanced AI Processing
ai_processing.description: We analyze your documents and automatically extract the most important concepts.

interactive_materials.title: Interactive Materials
interactive_materials.description: We create flashcards, quizzes, and summaries that adapt to your learning pace.

organization.title: Smart Organization
organization.description: Group your content by topics, subjects, or projects for more structured studying.

progress_tracking.title: Progress Tracking
progress_tracking.description: Measure your progress and identify areas that need more attention.

team.title: Our Team
team.description: We are a passionate team of educators, developers, and AI experts committed to improving the learning experience.

cta.title: Ready to transform your study?
cta.description: Join thousands of students who are already learning more efficiently.
